create_conformer_encoder_layer: create a ConformerEncoderLayer with configurable attention heads, feed-forward dimensions, and causal convolution settings
build_conformer_encoder: build a ConformerEncoder with NeMo conv subsampling, T5 relative attention bias, and streaming chunk masking
create_audio_embedding: create an AudioEmbedding module with Conformer encoder, optional Qformer downsampling, and linear or MLP projection
create_window_qformer: create a WindowQformer that applies transformer decoder layers over audio embedding windows
run_audio_embedding_forward: run the AudioEmbedding forward pass to convert audio features into hidden-dimension embeddings
